name: astromech-attendant-brew-trigger-draw
notes: Astromech Attendant is seeded directly onto the field (its own On Enter Gather-3x isn't the clause under test here -- OnBrew's 'whenever you brew' trigger is). Note: seeding an ALLY via the field-add bridge DOES fire its real enterAbilities macro as a side effect (verified live with a minimal repro) -- with the default champion this satisfies Astromech Attendant's own Class-Bonus-gated On Enter (IsClassBonusActive($player) with no class filter just requires ANY champion), so 3 random herb tokens appear on the field before the brew even happens; this is harmless noise for this fixture (assertions only check hand/memory counts and the brew trigger), but explains why the field has extra objects. The champion is CardID-patched to Arisanna, Astral Zenith (q3huqj5bba, CLERIC) so IsClassBonusActive($player,['CLERIC']) is satisfied for OnBrew's own check (PotionLogic.php ~247). Distilled Water (a NORM Potion, Brew -- One Herb) is seeded to hand along with its Herb ingredient (Blightroot); declaring Brew at materialize time (YES + choosing a herb) calls OnBrew($player), which draws a card into memory because Astromech Attendant is on the field with its Class Bonus active. Astromech Attendant's own presence also offers a fast-action Sacrifice opportunity on the remaining herb tokens; this must be explicitly declined ('-' then PASS/PASS) or Distilled Water is left stuck mid-resolution on the effect stack instead of landing on the field -- verified live: without the decline, Distilled Water never appears in any zone.

rulesClauses: Whenever you brew a Potion, draw a card into your memory.
